name: Gemini Embedding 2 Preview
description: Preview of Google's first multimodal embedding model, mapping text, images, video, audio, and PDFs into a single unified embedding space. Shut down on August 10, 2026; the replacement is Gemini Embedding 2.

sources.title: Gemini Embedding 2 model page
sources.notes: Supported data types and the 8,192 input token limit. Output dimension is flexible from 128 to 3072, which is not a token budget.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.notes: embedding-2-preview released March 10, 2026, shut down August 10, 2026, recommended replacement gemini-embedding-2.
